name: intentgauge
description: IntentGauge: measures an AI agent one intent at a time, with independent checks, repeated runs, regression gates and human-scored evidence

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js scripts/feedback-replay.test.mjs
scripts.dashboard: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dashboard runs
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run examples/rag/suite.json --replay examples/rag/outputs.json
